sermon.title: Did Jesus Christ Exist Before the Creation of the Heavens and the Earth? —August 21, 2022
sermon.series: Before the Foundation of the World
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: The Bible, authored by God, records history before Genesis 1: Christ shared the Father’s glory before the world was and was foreordained as the Lamb. The Word was God and created all things. A question time covers the begotten Son, the dead, the scars and the one God.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Opening scripture, worship and prayer by others; message from ~19:50, followed by audience questions.

chunks.section_question: Is there recorded history before Genesis 1?
chunks.short_answer: The Bible is an authentic ancient record, and its preface is at the end—God is its author.
chunks.text:
So you may want to get your pencil and paper out in case you get stirred up for any questions you can ask them at the end. We’re going to talk about did Jesus Christ exist before the creation of the heavens and the earth. Is there authentic recorded history before Genesis 1. All history books inform readers about the past. From authentic ancient records the Bible is an authentic ancient record. Books on origins of the universe. Teach readers. What was before what was during what was after an event and why the event and how the event took place and the Bible.

All scripture is inspired by God and is profitable for doctrine profitable for reproof profitable for correction and instruction in righteousness the whole Bible is about righteousness living right speaking right doing right treating others right.

faqs.question: Who wrote the Bible?
faqs.answer: God; men spoke as moved by the Holy Ghost.

faqs.question: Can you trace mankind to Adam?
Was Jesus’ glory secondary?
faqs.answer: No, the same glory as the Father’s.

faqs.question: Was there a literal lamb on the cross?
faqs.answer: No, it was Jesus in fleshly form.

faqs.question: Are the dead looking down from heaven?
faqs.answer: He points to John 3:13—no one has ascended but He who came down.

faqs.question: How will we know the real Messiah?
Do you need seminary to understand the Bible?
Why is divorce 50% in the church?
faqs.answer: Someone didn’t follow the knowledge of God’s word.
